segments.text: Want a $3,500 retro airport display for free? Someone tried charging 200 bucks for a web version, so a developer got
mad and built Flip Off out of pure open-source spite. It runs entirely in your browser with zero dependencies.
Just hit full screen to turn any monitor into a stunning mechanical flipboard complete with authentic clacking
